meta.title: Forge Vertical Business Directory
meta.description: A curated directory of Cape Town and South African businesses across tech, hospitality, automotive, and professional services.

listings.name: TripSpace Global
listings.description: Africa-focused hospitality marketplace connecting travellers and hosts without the 15–25% OTA commission. Flat monthly fee. AI travel companion Aria built in.

listings.name: Aurora Repair
listings.description: Intelligent vehicle damage assessment platform using AI to generate accurate repair quotes. Connects insurers and panel shops with real-time parts pricing.

listings.name: Forge Vertical
listings.tagline: Built for the future. From day one.
listings.description: Cape Town-based digital agency building websites, SaaS platforms, and AI integrations with security, SEO, GEO, and AEO built in from the first commit.

listings.name: Princess Vlei Lodge
listings.description: Boutique lakeside lodge in Cape Town offering a tranquil retreat close to the city. Multiple units. Perfect for short and extended stays.

listings.name: International Panel Shop
listings.description: Professional panel beating and spray painting in Cape Town. Insurance-approved repairs, dent removal, full vehicle restoration, and fleet services.

listings.name: Pressed In Time BD
listings.description: Professional garment care and laundry services with franchise locations across South Africa, Namibia, and Botswana.

listings.name: SiteBuild Studio
listings.description: Affordable website generation for Cape Town small businesses. Fill in your details, pay once, get a complete responsive website built by Gemini 2.5 Flash.

listings.name: Yoco
listings.description: South Africa's leading digital commerce platform. Over 200,000 merchants process more than R34 billion annually. Card machines, online payments, business tools.

listings.name: Naked Insurance
listings.description: South Africa's leading insurtech. Get a car, home, or valuables insurance quote in under 90 seconds. No call centre. AI-powered claims.

listings.name: Luno
listings.description: Cape Town-based cryptocurrency exchange making it safe and easy to buy, store, and learn about digital assets. Operating across Africa and globally.

listings.name: Aerobotics
listings.description: AI-powered drone analytics for farmers and insurers. Computer vision identifies plant stress, disease, and yield potential at scale for agricultural markets worldwide.

listings.name: Ozow
listings.description: Instant EFT and pay-by-bank technology for merchants and consumers. Over 6 million registered users. Now accepting cryptocurrency via MoneyBadger integration.
